# NFL Daily — 2026-08-07 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/07: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs signs a three-year extension, becoming the NFL's highest-paid running back. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jahmyr-gibbs-highest-paid-running-back-three-year-extension/)
- 08/07: Titans G Peter Skoronski agrees to a four-year, $100M extension, becoming the NFL's highest-paid guard. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49555284/sources-extension-makes-titans-peter-skoronski-top-paid-guard)
- 08/07: Bills agree to a four-year, $78.4M extension ($46M guaranteed) with RG O'Cyrus Torrence. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49552831/bills-agree-4-year-784m-deal-rg-ocyrus-torrence)
- 08/07: WR Stefon Diggs officially signs with the Commanders, his third team in three years. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49554390/stefon-diggs-settles-commanders-ups-nfl-best-talk)
- 08/07: Colts CB Cam Taylor-Britt suspended one game without pay for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy, will miss the season opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49555724/colts-cam-taylor-britt-suspended-1-game-violating-personal-conduct-policy)
- 08/07: Raiders QB Kirk Cousins and DE Maxx Crosby scuffled late in Friday's practice before teammates separated them. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49555077/raiders-cousins-crosby-scuffle-friday-practice)

## Transactions
- 08/07: Commanders sign WR Stefon Diggs. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)

- 08/06: Bears CB Kyler Gordon remains out, still rehabbing an offseason calf injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
